final: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) as avg_line_cost, CAST(SUM(derived_total_cost) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(product_price) AS REAL) as ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall_avg_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM invoice_stats), above_average AS (SELECT invoice_stats.invoice_number, invoice_stats.avg_line_cost, invoice_stats.ratio, invoice_stats.ratio - overall_avg_ratio.avg_ratio as excess FROM invoice_stats, overall_avg_ratio WHERE invoice_stats.ratio > overall_avg_ratio.avg_ratio) SELECT AVG(avg_line_cost) as avg_line_cost_of_kept, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio_of_kept, AVG(excess) as avg_excess_of_kept FROM above_average
